subject: Quick walkthrough request after benchmark download
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara@lumenanalytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick walkthrough after benchmark download

Hi Logan,

I downloaded the ‘Redwood Inference — End-to-end benchmark’ PDF this morning (great write-up). We’re evaluating inference options for a vector-search product, and I’d love a short walkthrough of how Redwood handles long-context batching and prefix caching — specifically around throughput and latency numbers for 1–4k prompt lengths.

Are you available for a 30-minute call this week? We’re based in San Francisco (PDT). I attached the benchmark report we generated on our side for context.

Thanks,
Sara Lin
Sr. Data Engineer | LumenAnalytics, Inc.
sara@lumenanalytics.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Lumen_benchmark_report.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara@lumenanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 10:08:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick walkthrough after benchmark download

Hi Sara —

Thanks for downloading and sending over your report — appreciated. I’m Logan from the Redwood Solutions team. Happy to run through the benchmark observations and map them to recommended serving configs (batching, KV cache settings, and a quantization tradeoff we commonly use).

Two quick options:
- Tue Apr 3, 11:00 AM PDT (30m)
- Wed Apr 4, 9:00 AM PDT (30m)

If those don’t work you can also pick a slot that fits your calendar here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min (timezone-aware).

Agenda (30m):
- 5m intro + context
- 15m review of your benchmark (where throughput/latency came from)
- 7m configuration recommendations + cost estimate
- 3m next steps / Qs

I’ve cc’d Ben (our AM) so he can follow the commercial side. If you want a technical deep dive we’ll bring Marissa (SE) on the follow-up.

Best,
Logan Wright
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

1) Our CTO, Miguel Torres (miguel@lumenanalytics.com), would like to join. Can you add him to the invite?
2) We realized one test in our report used a 6k context accidentally; the attached PDF is the full export — apologies if you spot the 6k run.

If we need to move, I can do Tue Apr 3 after 2pm PDT as well.

See you then,
Sara

Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick walkthrough after benchmark download — Confirmed / reschedule note

Hi Sara (and Miguel) —

Thanks for the quick booking and the heads-up on the 6k run — appreciated. I updated the meeting to include Miguel and added Marissa (SE) to the invite so we can talk kernel/quantization tradeoffs in more detail.

I also noticed you mentioned availability after 2pm on Tue — I’ve moved the call to Tue Apr 3 at 2:30 PM PDT to accommodate. Updated calendar invite should be hitting your inbox shortly. If the new time doesn’t work, please reply and we’ll pivot.

For the session I attached a short agenda + checklist to speed the review. If you have any logs or a short sample prompt set (JSON) you want us to load before the call, drop them in reply or share a Drive link.

Looking forward — we’ll aim to highlight configuration levers that reduce per-token cost while keeping latency within your SLOs.

Best,
Logan Wright
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_demo-agenda-v1.pdf
